opportunities.title: Death Knight Isn't a Class, It's a Paladin Reflavor: Here's the 5e Ruling
opportunities.why_now: WoW's D&D class list just went viral, and every table is about to ask how to build these 'classes' in actual 5e.
opportunities.angle: 60-sec breakdown: map each Warcraft 'class' (Death Knight, Demon Hunter, Evoker, Shaman) to an existing 5e subclass/reflavor with one mechanical tweak each — no homebrew bloat.

opportunities.title: We Watched CERN Make Antimatter. Here's What a Sphere of Annihilation Actually Does to Your Party.
opportunities.why_now: EN World's CERN visit piece is a free hook to talk real-world antimatter vs. the D&D item everyone fears but nobody runs correctly.
opportunities.angle: Dry ruling format: clarify Sphere of Annihilation interaction rules (control check, what it destroys, what survives) using the CERN headline as cold open.

opportunities.title: The One-Shot Mistake That Kills Your Table: A Ruling on Pre-Session Problem Proofing
opportunities.why_now: Gnome Stew's new Gnomecast episode on problem-proofing one-shots is fresh GM-advice content you can condense into a hard ruling.
opportunities.angle: Veteran-GM short: one concrete fix (e.g., always pre-roll initiative order for NPCs, cap save-or-die effects) framed as a non-negotiable prep rule.

opportunities.title: D&D Devs Are Unionizing Over 'Crunch' — So Let's Talk About Actual Rules Crunch
opportunities.why_now: The unionization story uses 'crunch' as labor jargon; it's a free pun to pivot into a mechanical discussion of high-crunch vs. low-crunch systems (5e vs. Shadowdark vs. DCC).
opportunities.angle: Wry comparison bit: show the same combat resolved in 5e (crunchy), Shadowdark (lean), and DCC (chaotic) to make the crunch joke land with an actual lesson.

opportunities.title: Steal This Mechanic: What Curseborne Covenant's Crowdfund Pitch Gets Right That 5e Doesn't
opportunities.why_now: This week's EN World crowdfunding roundup highlights new systems actively pitching fresh mechanics worth raiding for your home game.
opportunities.angle: Quick creature-tactic or spell-use-case translated from the new system's pitch into a usable 5e/Shadowdark house rule, credited honestly.
